task.title: Installing the HP Printer Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Install the HP printer driver to enable full printing functionality on a Windows 11 computer.

prereq.p: Ensure your computer is connected to the internet and the printer is powered on and connected to the same network.

step.cmd: Open a web browser and go to support.hp.com.
In the search box, enter your printer model number and press Enter.
Select your operating system as Windows 11 (64-bit).
Click Download next to the Full Feature Software package.
Once downloaded, double-click the installer file and follow the on-screen prompts.
step.info: The installation wizard will guide you through network or USB connection setup.

step.cmd: Click Finish when the installation is complete.

result.p: The HP printer driver is now installed. The printer should appear in SettingsBluetooth and devices Printers and scanners.

postreq.p: Print a test page to confirm the installation was successful.
